content.short: Hedgehog is a portfolio manager and trading application for crypto currencies.
content.description: Hedgehog, founded by Colton Dillion and Taylor Culbertson, is a cryptocurrency robo-adviser designed to help users manage digital assets. By connecting wallets and exchanges, it automatically surfaces competitive prices and presents a unified view of portfolios by syncing accounts across platforms. The platform offers an API that developers can use to integrate Hedgehog's endpoints into their applications. Hedgehog is also developing technology aimed at enabling trades at the best possible price.
